outcome: Fetal heart rate (FHR) abnormalities during and after ECV
cohort: The study included 980 women with a singleton fetus in breech presentation, at >34 weeks' gestation.
finding: Fetal heart rate abnormalities during and after external cephalic version are more frequent with lower estimated fetal weight and longer duration of the procedure.
mod_finding: Fetal heart rate abnormalities during and after ECV were not associated with the mode of delivery or the occurrence of fetal distress during subsequent labor.
